checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Matte black bottle remains recognizable throughout
must.why: Same matte black bottle with the same cap shape in all frames.

must.item: Bottle visibly turns slowly through roughly a quarter turn, not just sliding or enlarging
must.why: The cap loop changes orientation across frames, so there is some real rotation. The body is a plain cylinder, so the turn is subtle. The bottle also drifts left and may turn less than a full quarter.

must.item: Bottle stays upright without melting, bending or changing proportions
must.why: It stays upright and keeps its shape. It gets slightly wider mid-clip, which is minor.

must.item: Camera and wooden table remain stationary
must.why: The table and window stay put. The plant and chair edge shift a few pixels, which suggests a slight camera or background drift. The bottle also slides left by about 10 px.

must.item: Square, silent video of about 6 s
must.why: Frames are square 640×640 and the clip is stated as 6 s with no sound.

faults.what: The bottle drifts leftward by about 10 px rather than turning purely in place.
The background plant and chair shift slightly, which suggests a small camera or background wobble.
The rotation is hard to see because the bottle is a featureless cylinder. Only the cap loop shows the turn.

summary: The clip is a clean, faithful square 6 s animation of the bottle with a subtle turn visible in the cap loop, but the bottle drifts slightly left and the background shifts a little.
